## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes proportionate tests.
- [ ] Documentation and contracts are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, private endpoints, or proprietary fixtures are included.
- [ ] New code and assets can be distributed under the repository license once adopted.
- [ ] No commercial feature gate or customer-only policy was added to the public core.
